experiences.title: Export the invoice ledger as CSV
experiences.summary: Use when an operator needs a downloadable comma-separated invoice ledger, not merely an on-screen total.
experiences.rule: Generate a downloadable CSV from the filtered invoice ledger and preserve stable column ordering.

experiences.title: Alert purchasing when stock reaches its reorder floor
experiences.summary: Use when on-hand inventory falls below the replenishment threshold and purchasing needs a notification.

en: on-hand quantity drops under the restock floor

experiences.rule: Compare available quantity with the configured reorder floor and notify purchasing once per threshold crossing.

experiences.title: Keep an approval trail for customer refunds
experiences.summary: Use when refund decisions require an auditable record of requester, approver, reason, and time.

triggers: keep an approval trail for customer refunds

zh-CN: 记录退款申请人和审批人

experiences.rule: Persist who requested and approved each refund, the reason, amount, and decision timestamp.

experiences.title: Prevent meeting room bookings above capacity
experiences.summary: Use when a booking must reject attendee counts above a room's safe capacity.
experiences.rule: Reject a room booking when attendee count exceeds the selected room's configured capacity.

experiences.title: Remind owners before supplier contracts expire
experiences.summary: Use when contract owners need an advance renewal reminder for expiring supplier agreements.
experiences.rule: Notify the assigned owner before a supplier agreement reaches its renewal deadline.

experiences.title: Lock approved time entries after payroll cutoff
experiences.summary: Use when approved time entries must stop changing once payroll processing begins.

mixed: 发薪前 lock time entries after payroll cutoff

experiences.rule: Make approved time entries immutable after payroll cutoff while preserving an explicit correction workflow.
